title: Record the six-label central triple floor
body:
## Summary
- Every nonzero coefficient pair, including `w^2`, has a four-call commutator, and the existing twelve-call word still realizes the central triple.
- The stacked image of coefficients `1`, `w` and `w^2` is still at least three-dimensional on each side, so the floor remains six X-type calls and six Y-type calls.
- Partial, no new kappa. This records that floor. It does not search words.

## Test plan
